title: Delhi Police inspector presses attempt to murder, rioting charges against CJP protestors of 20 July march: Report
content:
• Charges were filed against CJP protesters for incidents that occurred during their march on July 20.
• Prohibitory orders were enforced under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) during the protest.
• The CJP protest primarily demanded the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan and called for reforms in the education sector.

title: CJP protest: Buying liquor this weekend? Delhi stores to close early at 8 pm, says report
content:
• Liquor shops in Delhi were ordered to shut early by 8 pm until the weekend, deviating from their usual closing time of 10 pm.
• The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) closed 18 metro stations from 07:30 AM onwards on Friday due to heightened security concerns.
• The Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) is leading protests at Jantar Mantar, demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan over the NEET paper leak incident.

title: Anti-paper leak law change moots stiffer penalty, wider coverage
content:
• The proposed amendments to the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024, will increase the maximum fine for organized paper leaks from the existing ₹1 crore to up to ₹10 crore.
• The scope of the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024, will be expanded to cover all public examinations, including state-level examinations, in addition to those conducted by central agencies like UPSC, SSC, IBPS, and NTA.
• The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024, which addresses paper leaks and unfair practices in public examinations, came into force on June 21, 2024.

title: Bangladesh President Shahabuddin resigns, Speaker Ahmed to serve as acting president
content:
• Bangladesh President Mohammed Shahabuddin resigned on Friday, two years ahead of his five-year tenure which began in April 2023.
• Parliament Speaker Hafiz Uddin Ahmed assumed the role of Acting President for 90 days, in accordance with Article 54 of the Constitution.
• A new President for Bangladesh must be elected within 90 days following the resignation of Mohammed Shahabuddin.

title: Ravneet Singh Bittu resigns as Union Minister of State for Railways — here's why
content:
• Union Minister of State for Railways and Food Processing Industries, Ravneet Singh Bittu, resigned from the Union Council of Ministers.
• President Droupadi Murmu accepted Ravneet Singh Bittu's resignation with immediate effect under clause (2) of Article 75 of the Constitution of India.
• Ravneet Singh Bittu joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in 2024 after leaving the Congress and unsuccessfully contested the Lok Sabha elections in 2024 from Ludhiana.

title: India's exports to UK may reach USD 115 bn by 2030 due to trade pact: Assocham
content:
• India's exports to the UK are projected to reach USD 115 billion by 2030 due to the trade pact, according to industry body Assocham.
• The UK free trade agreement between India and the UK came into force on July 15 this year.
• The total trade trajectory between India and UK is expected to expand from USD 58 billion in 2025-26 to USD 115 billion by 2030.

title: India-US 'economic partnership continues' to grow despite pending trade deal: USISPF CEO Mukesh Aghi
content:
• The US imposed a 10% tariff on goods imported from India under Section 301 over 'forced labour' concerns, a lower rate compared to the 12.5% initially proposed for India and imposed on other economies.
• On July 22, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar held talks in Manila, where they agreed on the importance of finalizing an 'almost complete' interim bilateral trade deal.
• Mukesh Aghi, President and CEO of the US-India Strategic Partnership Forum (USISPF), stated that nearly 60% of Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in India are American.

title: India's forex reserves rise $1.08 billion to $676.237 billion in week ended July 17
content:
• India's forex reserves rose by $1.08 billion to $676.237 billion in the week ended July 17.
• India's forex reserves touched a record high of $728.494 billion in the week ended February 27 this year.
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi appealed since May 11 for citizens to conserve foreign exchange by reducing overseas travel, limiting fuel consumption, and avoiding gold purchases for a year.

title: India, Israel conclude second round of trade pact negotiations
content:
• India and Israel concluded their second round of negotiations for a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) this week, with discussions held during July 20-23.
• The negotiations covered multiple critical areas including trade in goods and services, rules of origin, intellectual property rights, and customs procedures.
• Total merchandise trade between India and Israel stood at USD 3.93 billion in 2025-26.

title: West Bengal govt to be ‘prepared’ to deal with resistance to land acquisition policy: FM Dasgupta
content:
• West Bengal Finance Minister Swapan Dasgupta announced a new policy where the state government will acquire land for industries and infrastructure projects to attract investments.
• The news references the historical event of Tata Motors relocating its Nano plant from Singur, West Bengal, to Sanand, Gujarat, in 2008 due to anti-land acquisition protests.
• Finance Minister Swapan Dasgupta stated that the West Bengal government is 'unequivocally pro-business' and plans to acquire land to hand over to investors, despite the state facing a 'heavy debt burden'.
